description: Synchronous two-quadrant DC/DC buck/boost cell: average model at the plant timescale (switching ripple below our dt resolution, ignored). The inductor integrates from the duty-windowed effective leg voltage with the inverter-class knee + deadtime + Rce distortion on the winding side; the average draw from the high bus is duty * i_L and handles buck and boost directions by current sign. OpenGates freewheel-collapses with the family 2 ms evidence time constant. Duty is a controller-side external (host-assigned per control period; unwired zero-binds for open-loop scripts via set_input / PlantSetInput / rte sim 'plant-input').

inputPorts.name: Duty
inputPorts.description: High-side switch on-time fraction, percent (0-100). Controller-side external (unwired zero-binds; script per period via set_input).

outputPorts.name: I_L
outputPorts.description: Inductor current, A (signed: positive = high -> low).

outputPorts.name: I_High
outputPorts.description: Average draw from the high bus, A (= duty * i_L).

outputPorts.name: I_Low
outputPorts.description: Current into the low side, A (= i_L).

outputPorts.name: P_High
outputPorts.description: Power leaving the high bus, W (= V_High * I_High; DEcBus P_Draw sink for the high side).

outputPorts.name: P_Low
outputPorts.description: Power into the low side, W (= V_Low * I_Low).

outputPorts.name: P_Draw
outputPorts.description: Alias of P_High for DcBus wiring.

outputPorts.name: P_DrawLow
outputPorts.description: Alias of -P_Low for direct-wiring an LV-side DcBus P_Draw.

Vce0_V.description: Effective switch knee forward drop, V.
